rows.notes: Test/trial production of the first cell lines began 2026-09 (electrive); serial production was expected spring 2026 and slipped (S12). Not commercial yet, so status stays under_construction; flip to operational when series production is announced. Up-to-100 GWh/yr is the plan (EUR 7.34bn). Search snippets (not opened) put phase 1 at ~34 GWh; not used. v1 chemistry NMC and prismatic format unconfirmed -> null (one older trade piece even says Debrecen will make cylindrical cells). Module assembly has run since 2024 using imported cells (S12).

Phase 1 40 GWh broke ground 2025-07-26, completion targeted 2026. No news found dated after 2025-07 despite two searches; silence may mean it is progressing quietly or slipping, so confidence capped at 0.6. Phase 2 has no capacity figure.

Fuding is a county-level city administered by Ningde; the Fujian government figure (330 GWh built + 170 GWh under construction/planned) covers all CATL bases 'in the city' (Ningde) and is the only disclosed total. The page does not name Fuding, so inclusion is an inference (see summary). Fuding facts kept in the hub notes: planned total 149 GWh incl. 40 GWh sodium-ion phase 6 (S3). Fuding is not given a separate capacity so nothing is counted twice.

Phase 1 (30 GWh, EV + ESS) inaugurated 2023-10-27 per CATL; full plan 60 GWh over two phases. installed_as_of is the commissioning date because no later update was found. A phase-2 (30 GWh) cooperation agreement was reportedly signed Jan 2026 (search result; the gov.cn page returned 503 so not verified). Chemistry (v1 LFP and NMC), start_year and announced_year unconfirmed -> null.

Big change vs v1: v1 counted 160 as nameplate with 60 as the 2025 step; two sources now say all three phases (60 phase 1 from 2025-05-10, 40 'phase 3' from 2025-07-21, 60 phase 2 in 2026-04) are in production, 160 GWh. Phase numbering is inconsistent across press but totals agree. capacity_by_year_json: 2025 = 60+40 = 100 from the two 2025 start dates; 2026 = 160. S5 (Xinhua via Sina) says 160 fully in production but does not name CATL; S4 describes the same Yanzhou base. v1 chemistry (LFP and sodium-ion) and format unconfirmed -> null.

Operational (LY7 officially began production 2025-08-29, LY8 started same day, LY9 60 GWh signed 2025-11-26; S27/S33). NO open source found that states the site's current capacity: the only sourced figures are 126 GWh/yr after phase 4 (planned in Feb 2021, S26 - now stale because LY7 added a large unit in 2025) and LY9 = 60 GWh planned. LY7/LY8 GWh are not given by the Changzhou government or Sina pages. v1 126 and 'ramp' JSON therefore nulled rather than carried. For the lead: sourced building blocks are 126 (2021 plan, S26) + LY7 (unquantified) + LY8 (40 GWh per v1, unverified) + LY9 60 (planned, S33). Confidence 0.5 because a >=10 GWh plant has null capacity. HKEX prospectus (PDF) could not be text-extracted with the available tools; it may give this.

Operational: phase 1 began 2024-12 (S31; another report says July 2024), phase 2 cell plant 2025-09-30 adding 30 GWh (S8), phases 3 and 4 partly in production from 2026-06 and ramping (S9). Phases 3+4 correspond to the 'Zhongzhou Times project phase 2' of +60 GWh (S10), so 30 + 30 + 60 = 120 GWh matches v1, but I could not open any page that states phase 1's GWh or the base total, so nameplate and installed are null rather than inferred. Confidence 0.5 for that reason (large plant). Luoyang's 120 GWh nameplate is probably right; the lead may restore it as a low-confidence figure if an annual-report or gov page is found.

HUB row for all CATL cell bases in Ningde city: 330 GWh built plus 170 GWh under construction or planned (Fujian government/China Daily, 2026-01-16) -> nameplate 500 (includes 'planned', so firmness varies). Covers the HQ/Jiaocheng-Dongqiao plants and the Fuding Shidai base (planned 149 GWh incl. 40 GWh sodium-ion phase 6 announced May 2026, S3), which is removed as merged_into_hub. The source page does not name Fuding; inclusion is inferred from Fuding being a county-level city of Ningde. Ningde city also contains the Xiapu Times-FAW project (30 GWh at full build, a JV; not in this batch) which may or may not be in the 330 - flag for the FAW batch. capacity_ref_year left null: no year given for the 500. v1 geography/chemistry unconfirmed -> null. Cross-check: CATL reports 772 GWh total capacity and 321 GWh under construction at end-2025 (S1); bottom-up site sums across CATL rows exceed 772, so some row capacities elsewhere may be nameplate/planned rather than built.

The Lingang plant supplying Tesla was reported as a module-assembly base (S21) that 'does not have the capacity to produce cells' (S22). The 80 GWh figure was an unconfirmed Reuters-sourced rumour (v1 notes) and no source shows a cell line. A new 2.8bn yuan Lingang plant broke ground 2022-02 (S22) but its product and capacity were not stated and no later source was found. CATL's HKEX list reportedly counts Shanghai as one of 11 domestic 'battery manufacturing bases' (search snippet, not opened). Alternative considered: keep as update with null capacity. Rejected because there is no cell evidence at all; lead can reinstate if a cell line is found.

Weak: the May 2026 Sina/Weike piece still describes phase 1 stage 2 as 'expected to be handed over end-2025' and phase 2 (30 GWh, 5bn yuan) as targeting trial production Q2 2026, i.e. no confirmed commercial output found. Phase 1 (60 GWh, 13bn yuan; first lines handed over late 2023 per v1 timeline) has no sourced GWh quote from pages I could open, so nameplate/installed are null. v1 figure 90 = 60 + 30 plausible but unverified. The separate ~80 GWh 'high-performance lithium battery' project in the same Tongxiang park is added as its own row. announced_year 2022 is the phase-1 groundbreaking (2022-09, v1 timeline) and is weakly sourced. Confidence 0.4 on a >=10 GWh plant: no open page gives its capacity.

v1's 10.5 GWh (Qinghai government, Jan 2024) could not be re-opened (HTTP 503), so it is not carried. Sina 2025-07-24 says a 15 GWh technical-renovation project (plan: production Aug 2025) is under way at Qinghai Times; it does not say whether that is additive to or replaces existing lines. Status 'operational' rests on CATL's long-running Nanchuan base (v1; Xining is on CATL's HKEX list per search snippets) and is not quoted from an opened page. Small plant (~10-15 GWh).

10 plants built = 270 GWh, plus Sichuan Times phase 10 (30 GWh) under construction (S6, Aug 2026) -> nameplate 300 (270+30), matching the '300 GWh in 2026' target in Nov 2025 reporting. Nov 2025: 210 GWh after Times-Changan expansion (S7). Reports conflict by ~month (one says 300 GWh reached by Sept 2026); installed 270 is the latest dated figure. Marked hub: the 'base' is ~10 separately named plants (Sichuan Times phases, Times-Geely, Times-Changan) in two Yibin parks - already one row in v1, so no component rows to merge. v1 chemistry unconfirmed -> null.

Status set conservatively to what I could verify (50 GWh phase 1 announced and under construction 2021-22; plant-1 shell topped out 2022-09). CATL very likely operates it (Yichun appears in CATL's HKEX 13-base list per search snippet; v1 cites 70+ GWh from Xinhua) but I found no opened page confirming production or current capacity (the Xinhua 2024-12-20 page I opened does not mention CATL capacity). Lead: treat status as probably operational; needs a source. v1 70 GWh and LFP unconfirmed -> not carried.

Phase 1 (25 GWh design) production start ceremony 2022-05-30 (S19). Phase 2 (full energy-storage chain) broke ground Dec 2023, no GWh figure disclosed; no 2026 update found. nameplate 25 = phase 1 only. installed left null: reports say first 'factory one' started, not that all 25 GWh is producing. v1 chemistry LFP unconfirmed -> null. Electrive 2021-02-04 also gives 25 GWh/12bn yuan.

Design capacity 14 GWh/yr (EUR 1.8bn); first cells Dec 2022, in operation since 2023, 'working at high capacity' in Feb 2025. start_year 2022 = first cells December 2022 (S28 says first batteries produced Dec 2022). Expansion: one IWR report (May 2026, single source, not opened) says up to 60 GWh by end-2026; unconfirmed, not used. installed null because no source states what is commissioned vs the 14 GWh design. v1 NMC/prismatic unconfirmed -> null.

Phase 1 construction started 2025-04-24, 6.5bn yuan, 40 GWh/yr when operating. A search snippet (not opened) says mid-2027 target. No news after 2025-04 found, so freshness unknown; cap 0.6. Coordinates unchanged.

Groundbreaking 2025-11-26 (CATL release); up to 50 GWh LFP. Timeline conflicting in press (end-2026 vs ~2028; one report says construction concludes March 2028); no 2026 progress news found; start_year and capacity_ref_year nulled (v1 2026/2030 unsupported). 50/50 JV per v1/press. One row only; Stellantis's other partners not double counted.

Upgraded from under_construction: Aug 2026 report says the plant 'quietly entered phased commercial operations' while trial runs continue, official inauguration pending; Nov 2026 just-auto says CATIB has begun production. Initial phase 6.9 GWh/yr, to scale to 15 GWh. installed 6.9 is the phase-1 capacity, not a measured output; ramp status unclear. InvestorTrust says the plant makes cells (lithium-ion, sub-chemistry not given) feeding pack lines; just-auto says only 'EV battery', so cell vs module remains moderately uncertain. v1 NMC/70-30 split not confirmed on opened pages -> chemistry null; JV partners given without percentages (CNBC Indonesia snippet says CBL 70% / IBC 30%, not opened). A figure of 40 GWh floated by a minister is aspirational and ignored.
